review:
The Great Stick-Up is a crime-themed slot set in a rural American town, with cash, maps, handcuffs and detective symbols. Pragmatic Play describes it as packed with features and mechanics, with bandits lurking around every corner.

The provider's page doesn't detail the features, but the in-game screens advertise wins of up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.3%, a little under the studio's usual top version. Because the official description is thin, the demo is the best way to see how the features work. It's a good match for fans of heist themes who enjoy discovering a game's mechanics through play.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
